subject.title: feat: validate required run artifacts against a schema (`--require-artifact-schema`)

question: Should Crabbox permanently expose this custom fail-closed JSON Schema subset through `--require-artifact-schema`?
rationale: The PR creates a new user-facing CLI and schema-language compatibility contract; implementation correctness alone cannot determine whether maintainers want to own that contract.

options.title: Adopt the subset contract
options.body: Accept the documented five-keyword subset as a stable initial contract after the parser defect and live-proof gate are resolved.

options.title: Use a standard validator
options.body: Replace the custom subset with a maintained JSON Schema implementation before exposing the flag.

options.title: Keep validation repository-owned
options.body: Decline the flag and continue requiring each remote command to validate its own evidence before completion.

recommendation.title: Adopt the subset contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented five-keyword subset as a stable initial contract after the parser defect and live-proof gate are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects Crabbox's central run CLI and long-term artifact evidence contract.
